findings.title: Dashboard 'Recent waterings' renders a malformed response as rows of 'Never' instead of an error
findings.expected: A non-list response shows an error message in the Recent waterings section
findings.actual: 14 table rows each showing 'Never', an empty bed and '–'; no alert

findings.title: Waterings page crashes on a non-list response (reduce is not a function), navigation never completes
findings.expected: A visible error on the Waterings page
findings.actual: Uncaught 'waterings.value?.reduce is not a function'; the beds page stays on screen with no error shown
findings.evidence: {"alerts":[],"text":["Partial shade","Shade","Notes","Add bed","All beds","North bed","Full sun","PLANTS","2","HARVESTED","2.55 kg","LAST WATERED","12 Nov 2026, 19:35","Water now"],"pageErrors":["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"]} | {"alerts":[],"text":["Partial shade","Shade","Notes","Add bed","All beds","North bed","Full sun","PLANTS","2","HARVESTED","2.55 kg","LAST WATERED","12 Nov 2026, 19:35","Water now"],"pageErrors":["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"]}

findings.title: Past watering accepts year-1 date and reports it as recorded
findings.expected: An absurd far-past date such as 0001-01-01 is refused with a reason
findings.actual: Saved with 201; success notice 'Recorded 2 L on 1 Jan 1.' and the entry shows in the log
findings.evidence: {"alerts":["Recorded 2 L on 1 Jan 1."],"added":1} | {"alerts":["Recorded 2 L on 1 Jan 1."],"added":1}

findings.title: Waterings page load error offers no way to retry
findings.expected: After a failed load, a Retry / Try again control once the fault clears
findings.actual: Only the error text 'Injected 500' is shown; no retry control, reload is needed

findings.title: Dashboard recent waterings error offers no way to retry
findings.expected: A retry control next to the 'could not load' error
findings.actual: Error text only, no retry control (refresh is not even destructured for waterings)

findings.title: Filter by unknown bed id shows 'No waterings for this bed' while the Bed select shows no selection
findings.expected: The select and the list agree (unknown bed reset to All beds or flagged)
findings.actual: Select has no selected option (looks like All beds) while the list is filtered and says 'No waterings for this bed'
